overview_description.description:
Vezeeta is the digital healthcare platform in MEA that connects patients with healthcare providers and health services. 

Patients are able to search, compare, book, and review the best doctors in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and Lebanon. It also provides innovative SaaS solutions to healthcare providers in the region. Vezeeta empowers millions of patients through data and the ability to better access healthcare in the region. With over 200,000 verified reviews, patients are able to search, compare, and book the best doctors in just 1 minute. Doctors also provide Patients with seamless healthcare experiences through our clinic management software.

identifier.value: Nana Frimpong Vice President, Africa @ Vezeeta

about_short_description.short_description: Vezeeta provides patients with a digital healthcare booking platform and management software.

product.name: Vezeeta Digital Healthcare Booking Platform
product.description: An online platform that enables patients to search for doctors, view available appointment times, and book medical consultations either in clinics, hospitals, at home, or via telemedicine.

identifier.value: Vezeeta Clinic and Practice Management Software

product.name: Vezeeta Clinic and Practice Management Software
product.description: A software solution designed to help clinics and healthcare providers manage appointments, patient records, and clinic operations digitally.

identifier.value: Vezeeta Pharmacy Ordering and Delivery Service

product.name: Vezeeta Pharmacy Ordering and Delivery Service
product.description: A service that allows patients to order medications online through the Vezeeta platform and have them delivered from partner pharmacies.

product.name: Vezeeta Subscription Service 'Shamel'
product.description: A subscription-based service offering users discounts on medical consultations, diagnostic services, clinic visits, surgeries, and pharmacy supplies within the Vezeeta network.

identifier.value: Vezeeta Loyalty Programs (Vezeeta Care and Move & Earn)

product.name: Vezeeta Loyalty Programs (Vezeeta Care and Move & Earn)
product.description: Loyalty programs that reward users with points for pharmacy purchases and physical activity, which can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.
